items.title: GPT-6.1 Terra in Work and Codex
items.text: GPT-6.1 Terra is now available in ChatGPT Work and Codex on Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu plans. It's a fast, efficient model for professional work that combines strong image understanding with precise computer use.
candidateLines: GPT-6.1 Terra is now available in ChatGPT Work and Codex on Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu plans. It's a fast, efficient model for professional work that combines strong image understanding with precise computer use.

Reason about images and screens, then act on what you find across your browser, desktop, and apps. Terra also provides clear, direct writing that puts results first and explains supporting details in plain language.

Choose GPT-6.1 Terra from the model list in Advanced in the ChatGPT desktop app or ChatGPT Work on the web. Work also supports Terra on mobile. The model isn't available in Chat and does not support UAE inference residency. Enterprise access depends on workspace availability and administrator controls.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.314
items.text: Added permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories: Write, Edit and NotebookEdit refuse paths outside the working directories in every permission mode
candidateLines: Added permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories: Write, Edit and NotebookEdit refuse paths outside the working directories in every permission mode

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.316
items.text: Added CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK, which turns the ultrathink keyword off
candidateLines: Added CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK, which turns the ultrathink keyword off
Added pooled group budgets to the Claude apps gateway: one monthly budget that a group's members share, on top of each member's own limit, set with pooled_budget on the spend limits admin API
Added CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP to keep system cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop, for servers whose private CA needs one
